### CODE
const m = window.__XLSX; const num = window.__num;
const files = {2023:'23in01ira.xlsx',2022:'22in01ira.xlsx',2021:'21in01ira.xlsx',2020:'20in01ira.xlsx',2019:'19in01ira.xlsx',2018:'18in01ira.xlsx',2017:'17in01ira.xlsx',2016:'16in01ira.xls',2015:'15in01ira.xls',2014:'14in01ira.xls',2013:'13in01ira.xls',2012:'12in01ira.xls',2011:'11in01ira.xls',2010:'10in01ira.xls',2009:'09in01ira.xls',2008:'08in01ira.xls',2007:'07in01ira.xls',2006:'06in01ira.xls',2005:'05in01ira.xls',2004:'04in01ira.xls'};
const T = {};
for (const [yr, f] of Object.entries(files)) {
  const r = await fetch('https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-soi/' + f);
  const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();
  const wb = m.read(new Uint8Array(buf), {type:'array'});
  const ws = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];
  const rows = m.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, {header:1, raw:false, defval:''});
  const hdrIdx = rows.findIndex(rw => rw.some(c => /Withdrawals/i.test(String(c))));
  const h = rows[hdrIdx];
  const wcol = h.findIndex(c => /Withdrawals/i.test(String(c)));
  const fcol = h.findIndex((c,i) => i > wcol && /fair market/i.test(String(c)));
  const rcol = h.findIndex(c => /^Rollovers/i.test(String(c).trim()));
  const ccol = h.findIndex(c => /Roth conversions/i.test(String(c)));
  T[yr] = {};
  for (let i = hdrIdx + 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const lab = String(rows[i][0]).replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/\[\d\]/g,'').trim();
    let key = null;
    if (/^Total/i.test(lab)) key = 'total'; else if (/^Traditional/i.test(lab)) key = 'trad'; else if (/^Roth/i.test(lab)) key = 'roth'; else if (/^SEP/i.test(lab)) key = 'sep'; else if (/^SIMPLE/i.test(lab)) key = 'simple';
    if (key) T[yr][key] = {wn: num(rows[i][wcol]), wa: num(rows[i][wcol+1]), fn: num(rows[i][fcol]), fa: num(rows[i][fcol+1]), rolla: num(rows[i][rcol+1]), conva: num(rows[i][ccol+1])};
  }
}
window.__T1 = T;
const pct = (a,b) => (a!=null && b) ? (100*a/b).toFixed(2) : 'na';
let out = 'year|type|withdrawers|w_amt_$K|EOY_holders|EOY_FMV_$K|prior_EOY_FMV_$K|withdrawers/holders_%|amt/EOY_FMV_%|amt/prior_EOY_FMV_%|avg_withdrawal_$\n';
const yrs = Object.keys(T).sort();
for (const yr of yrs) for (const k of ['total','trad','roth']) {
  const v = T[yr][k]; const prev = T[String(+yr-1)] ? T[String(+yr-1)][k] : null;
  out += [yr, k, v.wn, v.wa, v.fn, v.fa, prev ? prev.fa : 'na', pct(v.wn, v.fn), pct(v.wa, v.fa), prev ? pct(v.wa, prev.fa) : 'na', v.wn ? Math.round(1000*v.wa/v.wn) : 'na'].join('|') + '\n';
}
out
